<a id="game_over"></a>
### [`game_over`](../../../../src/game/game_over.asm#L6) `$9D37`

*label*

Then it clears columns 13 to 29 of these rows, row by row. It continues at hiscore_check.

### [`game_over_tone`](../../../../src/game/game_over.asm#L55) `$9D93`

*routine*

Plays a falling sawtooth tone on voice 3: the frequency high byte goes from $40 to 1. Uses $3c and $0f.
